title: Design System: Takala Wang Resume Workbench

display.purpose: Name, archive, section, and project titles.

label.purpose: Dates, taxonomy, navigation, and work-file metadata.

shadows.name: paper-stack
shadows.purpose: Separates the layered first-viewport work file from the paper ground.

motion.name: signal-transition
motion.purpose: Links and navigation respond without distracting from reading.

components.name: Signal link
components.description: A direct action rendered as an editorial file annotation.
components.css: .ds-signal-link { display: inline-flex; gap: .65rem; padding: .8rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #145a78; color: #172733; font: 500 .7rem/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, gap .18s ease; } .ds-signal-link:hover { gap: 1rem; color: #145a78; border-color: #e6b84f; }

components.name: Document stack
components.description: Three offset paper sheets establish the first viewport's workbench metaphor.
components.html: FILE / 001REAL WORK
components.css: .ds-document-stack { position: relative; width: 280px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; } .ds-document-sheet { position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(23,39,51,.42); background: #f3efe7; box-shadow: 10px 12px 0 rgba(23,39,51,.08); } .ds-document-sheet-back { transform: translate(-18px,18px) rotate(-7deg); background: #d8d1c4; } .ds-document-sheet-front { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 2rem; color: #172733; }

components.name: Project entry
components.description: A full-width project record joining artifact, contribution, and outcome without a card shell.
components.css: .ds-project-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4rem minmax(0,1fr); gap: 1.5rem; padding: 2.4rem 0 7rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(23,39,51,.18); } .ds-project-beacon { color: #145a78; font: 600 .64rem/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-project-entry h3 { color: #172733; font: 600 clamp(2.6rem,6vw,6.6rem)/.86 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.085em; }

narrative.overview: A paper-first engineering archive where files, annotations, and real artifacts create the page rhythm.

rules.name: The Registration Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies information; yellow marks a file, a focus state, or attention.

dos: Do use screenshots as source material.
Do keep contribution and outcome beside the project.
donts: Don't use star fields or space metaphors.
